name: postgres-mcp
description: MCP server wrapper for PostgreSQL - reads credentials from .env with configurable key mapping and safe read-only defaults.

postgresMcp.keyHost.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the database host. Leave empty to use the default: DB_HOST. (Sets MCP_KEY_HOST)

postgresMcp.keyPort.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the database port. Leave empty to use the default: DB_PORT. (Sets MCP_KEY_PORT)

postgresMcp.keyName.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the database name. Leave empty to use the default: DB_NAME. (Sets MCP_KEY_NAME)

postgresMcp.keyUser.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the database user. Leave empty to use the default: DB_USER. (Sets MCP_KEY_USER)

postgresMcp.keyPass.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the database password. Leave empty to use the default: DB_PASS. (Sets MCP_KEY_PASS)

postgresMcp.keySslMode.description: Name of the .env variable that holds the SSL mode (e.g. require). Leave empty to use the default: DB_SSLMODE. (Sets MCP_KEY_SSLMODE)

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test

author: Edelcio Molina <https://github.com/edelciomolina>
